func run(ctx):
    ctx.add_mesh("box", "Floor", null, {"size": Vector3(20, 0.2, 20), "position": Vector3(0, 0.1, 0)})
    ctx.add_mesh("box", "Wall_North", null, {"size": Vector3(20, 3, 0.5), "position": Vector3(0, 1.5, -9.75)})
    ctx.add_mesh("box", "Wall_East", null, {"size": Vector3(0.5, 3, 20), "position": Vector3(9.75, 1.5, 0)})
    ctx.add_mesh("box", "Wall_West", null, {"size": Vector3(0.5, 3, 20), "position": Vector3(-9.75, 1.5, 0)})
    ctx.add_mesh("box", "Wall_South_Left", null, {"size": Vector3(8, 3, 0.5), "position": Vector3(-6, 1.5, 9.75)})
    ctx.add_mesh("box", "Wall_South_Right", null, {"size": Vector3(8, 3, 0.5), "position": Vector3(6, 1.5, 9.75)})
    ctx.add_mesh("cylinder", "Fountain", null, {"top_radius": 1.5, "bottom_radius": 1.5, "height": 1.0, "position": Vector3(0, 0.5, 0)})
    ctx.ensure_environment()
    ctx.add_camera(Vector3(0, 22, 26), Vector3(0, 0, 0), true)
    var saved = ctx.save_scene()
    return {"saved": saved}
